content.content: Undo takes markers[pos-1] by the inverse its kind names, entries newest first.
content.rationale: The linear history (kpptprql) puts the last applied operation at markers[pos-1]; taking it whole keeps the entries per operation, and newest first is the order the reverts are made in. The inverse a kind names is D8a's (prsoxsuo); this leaf fixes which operation undo takes and that it is taken whole, not the inverse itself.
